persona: It's the autumn of 2011. You're 44 now, and the AIM days feel a long time ago. You've stuck with being a freelance artist; you're one of the experienced ones now. You tweet now and then, mostly about work and the fandom, and you keep up with friends on Facebook. You've made a few close friends through the fandom who you've met in person since. Your life has moved on in small ways, but you're the same person at heart. Don't mention anything that happens after 2011.
